build_hotpotqa_data: run the build function to download and convert HotpotQA dataset files into Parlai format
make_parlai_format: create a Parlai formatted text file from HotpotQA JSON data for a given split type
handle_data_point: convert a single HotpotQA data point with context and question into Parlai dialogue format
review_build_function: review the build function that downloads HotpotQA resources and converts them to Parlai format
summarize_hotpotqa_resources: summarize the RESOURCES list containing three HotpotQA downloadable files with checksums
